high_level_description: The image features a person standing on what appears to be a runway or a fashion show setting. The individual is wearing a long, flowing dress with a vibrant floral pattern. The dress is predominantly white with a variety of colorful flowers, including reds, pinks, blues, and yellows, interspersed with green leaves and butterflies. The dress has long sleeves and a high neckline, with green accents at the cuffs and waistline. The person is also wearing a statement necklace with large, colorful gemstones that complement the dress. They have on white strappy high-heeled sandals.
